display.fontSizeSubtitle: Size of the lyric text in pixels.
display.blurSubtitle: Blur non-active lyric lines for focus.
display.backgroundMotionSubtitle: Apply fragmented artwork with slow drifting motion to the background.
display.linesBeforeSubtitle: Number of preceding lines to show when auto-scrolling.
display.autoResumeDelaySubtitle: Time to wait before auto-scrolling resumes after you manual scroll.
display.keepScreenOnSubtitle: Prevent device from sleeping while lyrics screen is active.
display.artworkMinSizeSubtitle: Reject artwork from media sources whose shorter side is below this threshold, then try alternate sources. Set to 0 to accept any size.

translation.targetLanguageDescription: Enter language codes separated by commas. The app will try to find the first available translation in the specified order. Values are case-sensitive.
translation.targetLanguageNoteMusixmatch: * Musixmatch uses "zht" for Chinese (Traditional) and "zh" for Chinese (Simplified)
translation.targetLanguageNoteLlm: * LLM requires netural language input, use prefix "llm: [English]" to indicate the target language
translation.targetLanguageNoteCJK: * QQ Music and Netease Music only supports "zh_CN"
translation.alignmentThresholdSubtitle: Min % similarity required to pair translation with original line.
translation.coverageThresholdSubtitle: Min % of current lyric lines that must match a cached translation. Only used when source providers differ.
translation.llmReasoningSubtitle: Set the model's reasoning effort level. Select "auto" to use default parameters without explicitly passing the reasoning field.

lyricConfig.sectionDescription: Configure how lyrics are fetched and processed.
lyricConfig.globalOffsetSubtitle: Set a default offset for all lyrics (e.g. if your device has audio latency).
lyricConfig.trimSubtitle: Attempt to remove staff/metadata lines from selected providers.

cache.lyricsCacheDescription: Clearing the cache will force the app to search for lyrics again.
cache.clearDialogContent: Are you sure you want to clear all cached lyrics?
cache.artworkCacheDescription: Clearing the cache will force the app to download artwork again.
cache.artworkClearDialogContent: Are you sure you want to clear all cached artwork?

experimental.sectionDescription: Try out new features. Some may be unstable.
experimental.richInlineFix: Rich Parts Fonts Size Glitching Fix
experimental.richInlineFixSubtitle: Enable the font size adjustment (divide by 0.9) for rich inline lyrics. This fixes alignment issues with certain fonts, or on some devices.

priority.sectionDescription: Reorder providers to prioritize where we fetch lyrics from first. Drag below "DISABLED AREA" to disable.

providers.neteaseDescription: Chinese music service, community driven lyrics catalog
providers.qqmusicDescription: Chinese music streaming service by Tencent

misc.traySubtitle: Show a Fluent Lyrics icon in the system tray with quick show/hide and quit actions. Requires AppIndicator on Linux (libayatana-appindicator).
misc.hideToTraySubtitle: When you close the main window, hide it to the tray instead of quitting. Lyrics and translations keep fetching in the background; UI rendering pauses while hidden. Use the tray menu to quit.
misc.unsupported: There is nothing here on this platform yet — system tray and lyrics streaming are only available on Linux and macOS desktops.
misc.streamDescription: Append the currently-sung lyric line to a plain text file as playback advances. The translation file mirrors the lyrics file line-for-line; lines without a translation become empty lines so external tools can index by line number. Useful for OBS, status bars, or `tail -n 1`. Leave a path empty to disable that output — the previous file (if Fluent Lyrics created it) will be removed.
